command: ps -p 8612 -o pid,cmd --no-headers 2>&1; echo ---; cat /proc/8612/cmdline 2>/dev/null | tr '\0' ' '; echo; echo ---services---; systemctl --user list-units --type=service --state=running 2>&1 | grep -i 'shim\|claude\|crush\|8420'; echo ---node---; which node; node --version 2>&1; echo ---which claude fullpath---; readlink -f $(which claude)
